input.quote: 14. INSURANCE. Throughout the term of this Agreement, Contractor shall maintain workers compensation insurance in the amount required by statute, comprehensive general liability insurance with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000) and professional errors and omissions insurance for bodily injury, property damage or other losses with coverage of at least one million dollars ($1,000,000), in connection with the provision of Services by Contractor pursuant to the terms of this Agreement.
input.rationale: Clause 14 (p0048) carries workers' compensation as required by statute, CGL of USD 1,000,000, E&O of USD 1,000,000 and certificates on request, but no cyber/privacy coverage at all. Contractor handles our Confidential Information (including Company records and data, cl. 8/p0038) and may access Company computer systems (cl. 1(c)/p0007), so cyber cover is required. The clause therefore fails the fallback, which needs E&O of USD 1,000,000 (already met verbatim) plus cyber cover of USD 2,000,000. We target the fallback with the shortest possible edit: inserting cyber and privacy liability cover of USD 2,000,000 into the existing sentence and leaving every other coverage, the certificates mechanic and all untouched wording verbatim. We note only in passing (not as a deviation) that the preferred position would also add a CGL aggregate limit and higher E&O/cyber limits.
